claim: shadcn/ui's official Tailwind v4 page documents the CSS-first migration: tailwind.config.js dropped in favour of @theme inline, HSL colours converted to OKLCH, tailwindcss-animate deprecated for tw-animate-css, data-slot on every primitive, forwardRef removed for React 19.
quote: Deprecated forwardRefs and adjust types ... Every primitive now has a data-slot attribute for styling. ... We've replaced the deprecated @tailwindcss/line-clamp and tailwindcss-animate with tw-animate-css.

claim: The Tailwind v4 upgrade requires moving :root/.dark out of @layer base, wrapping colour values in hsl()/oklch() at :root and using @theme inline so utilities reference var(--x) directly rather than hsl(var(--x)).
quote: wrap the color values in hsl() and add the inline option to @theme

claim: In July 2026 shadcn/ui made Base UI (v1.6.0) the default primitive layer for new projects; Radix is not deprecated and every component ships for both, with `shadcn init -b radix` keeping Radix.
quote: Radix is a mature, tested library ... To keep a new project on Radix: pnpm dlx shadcn init -b radix

claim: shadcn/ui 2025-2026 changelog: Tailwind v4 support (Feb 2025), React 19 + Sidebar (Oct 2024/2025), monorepo support (Dec 2024/2025), CLI 3.0 + MCP (Aug 2025), CLI v4 (Mar 2026), unified radix-ui package (Feb 2026), shadcn eject (May 2026), GitHub registries (Jun 2026), Base UI default (Jul 2026).
quote: July 2026 - Base UI Default: Base UI became the default component library, replacing Radix as the standard pick.

claim: shadcn CLI v4 (March 2026) adds --dry-run/--diff/--view inspection flags, `shadcn info`, `shadcn docs`, presets via `init --preset`, `--monorepo` scaffolding, `--base` to pick Radix or Base UI, and registry:base to distribute a whole design system in one install.
quote: --dry-run, --diff, and --view flags let users inspect registry changes before installation ... Use --base to choose between Radix or Base UI primitives when initializing projects.

claim: February 2026: shadcn components moved from dozens of @radix-ui/react-* packages to the single unified `radix-ui` package, migratable with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest migrate radix`.
quote: components that previously used "@radix-ui/react-dialog" now import "{ Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from 'radix-ui'"

claim: tailwind-merge v3 drops Tailwind v3 support and adds Tailwind v4 support; theme scales were renamed to the v4 theme-variable namespaces, custom separators removed, prefix syntax changed from 'tw-' to 'tw', validators.isLength removed - so tailwind-merge v2 + Tailwind v4 mis-resolves class conflicts.
quote: Tailwind CSS v4 removed support for custom separators for modifiers in Tailwind CSS classes and now only the default separator `:` is allowed.

claim: tailwind-merge is at v3.6.0 (published 2026-05-10), supports Tailwind v4.0-v4.3, and users on Tailwind v3 must stay on tailwind-merge v2.6.x; the repo has 5,653 stars and 28 open issues (last push 2026-07-13).
quote: Supports Tailwind v4.0 up to v4.3 (if you use Tailwind v3, use tailwind-merge v2.6.0)

claim: The shadcn CLI npm package is at 4.13.0, published 2026-07-03 (canary 4.2.0-canary.0, rc 4.10.0-rc).
shadcn's cn() helper is literally twMerge(clsx(inputs)) - clsx for conditional class composition plus tailwind-merge for last-wins conflict resolution.

As of July 2026 the shadcn Button still uses class-variance-authority (cva) for variants, imports Slot from the unified `radix-ui` package, and uses the Tailwind v4 size-* utility (e.g. size-9, size-4) instead of paired w-*/h-*.
quote:
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui" ... size: { icon: "size-9", "icon-xs": "size-6", "icon-sm": "size-8", "icon-lg": "size-10" }

claim: shadcn/ui's own v4 app pins react 19.2.3, @base-ui/react 1.6.0, radix-ui ^1.4.3, tailwind-merge ^3.6.0, class-variance-authority ^0.7.1, clsx ^2.1.1, @tailwindcss/postcss ^4.3.0 - i.e. cva 0.7.1 is still the production dependency.
quote: '@base-ui/react': '1.6.0', 'class-variance-authority': '^0.7.1', 'clsx': '^2.1.1', 'radix-ui': '^1.4.3', 'react': '19.2.3', 'tailwind-merge': '^3.6.0'

claim: shadcn's Tailwind v4 stylesheet uses @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "shadcn/tailwind.css"; @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *)); and an @theme inline block mapping --color-* to bare CSS vars.

class-variance-authority's last stable release is 0.7.1, published 2024-11-26 - roughly 20 months without a release as of July 2026 - while its successor package `cva` sits at 1.0.0-beta.7 (published 2026-07-13), still beta after 2+ years.
tailwind-variants (the main cva alternative, from HeroUI) is at 3.2.2, published 2025-11-22, and offers slots/compound-slots plus built-in tailwind-merge.
quote: tailwind-variants dist-tags: {'latest': '3.2.2'}; 3.2.2 published 2025-11-22T22:46:05.151Z

claim: Tailwind CSS latest is 4.3.2 (2026-06-29); the v3 line is frozen at 3.4.19 under the v3-lts tag (2025-12-10).
components.json's tailwind.config field must be left blank for Tailwind v4; tailwind.cssVariables and tailwind.baseColor cannot be changed after init.
quote: For Tailwind CSS v4, leave this blank. ... This cannot be changed after initialization.

claim: Vite + Tailwind v4 + shadcn wiring needs @tailwindcss/vite in vite.config plugins, an '@' -> ./src resolve alias, and matching baseUrl/paths in BOTH tsconfig.json and tsconfig.app.json; no PostCSS config and no tailwind.config.ts.
quote: plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()], resolve: { alias: { "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "./src") } }

claim: shadcn monorepo support uses Turborepo with apps/web + packages/ui, a components.json per workspace (style/iconLibrary/baseColor must match), globals.css centralised in packages/ui/src/styles, and imports via @workspace/ui/components.
quote: Ensure you have the same `style`, `iconLibrary` and `baseColor` in both `components.json` files.

claim: The shadcn MCP server lets agents browse/search/install registry items in natural language and works with the public registry, third-party registries, and authenticated private registries.
quote: The shadcn MCP server works out of the box with any shadcn-compatible registry, including ... private registries for internal component libraries, and namespaced registries configured with @namespace syntax.

claim: Namespaced registries are configured in components.json under `registries` with a {name} URL template and optional auth headers; the system is decentralised with no central registrar, so teams can host internal design systems.
quote: The system is completely decentralized with no central registrar, allowing teams to create any namespace they want

claim: The HN thread on shadcn defaulting to Base UI (2026-07-05, 282 points) shows a live split over the copy-in model: critics call it churn and non-differentiating, defenders cite MUI v4->v5 upgrade hell.
quote: chvid: 'The copy paste approach may be easily modifiable but creates new problems - ie now there is an upgrade ai agent for something that should just be ticking up a version number.'

claim: On the same HN thread, an engineer who migrated a large app from Material UI to shadcn argues shadcn's per-component upgrades beat MUI's all-or-nothing major-version API rewrites.
quote: oneneptune: 'each major version update was a tedious process because they completely upended many APIs. We've migrated to shadcn, and upgrades are now easy; we can upgrade a single component ... With MaterialUI we had to update EVERYTHING to their new APIs'

claim: HN critics of shadcn in July 2026: 'The copy paste approach is just a plain bad idea', 'every app that use shadcn use 100% same [look]', and skepticism about churning Stitches -> Radix -> Base UI.
quote: dbbk: 'The copy paste approach is just a plain bad idea, I am not sure why this doesn't get more criticism' / sreekanth850: 'Bigger issue, every app that use shadcn use 100% same. I still have to figure how people differentiate their brand using shadcn.'

claim: A January 2026 HN comment captures the anti-shadcn position: over-complex Radix-derived components (radio, select) and a leaner non-shadcn POC.
quote: The biggest mistake I did in 2025 was picking shadcn because it was so hyped. Saw it importing from radix anytime you enter a command. First red flag. Then I saw the radio component. Second red flag. ... we did a POC for the same project before that without shadcn and looking back, it's so much leaner and easier.

quote: The new color changes made some of my custom themed UI to be extremely ugly.

claim: shadcn-ui/ui discussion #6797 documents the common Vite + Tailwind v4 + shadcn failure mode where component styling 'looks weird' after install, typically from stale tailwind.config/PostCSS setup or an unmigrated globals.css.
quote: Styling for shadcn components looks weird after installing tailwind v4 with latest shadcn using Vite

claim: A v3->v4 shadcn migration write-up lists the concrete breakage: renamed utilities (shadow-sm->shadow-xs, rounded-sm->rounded-xs, ring->ring-3, outline-none->outline-hidden), removed *-opacity-* utilities, tailwindcss-animate -> tw-animate-css, tailwind-merge bump, Vite projects must switch to @tailwindcss/vite and can delete postcss.config.js.
quote: Renamed utilities require find-and-replace across projects: shadow-sm -> shadow-xs, rounded-sm -> rounded-xs, ring -> ring-3, outline-none -> outline-hidden
